description.value:
One of the last weapons released by Sanroo Firearms in the 2050s, the Matchmaker is less of a new design and more of a traditional AMR packed to the brim with upgrades and optics. Yet, that doesn’t change the reality that this pretty-pink, love-seeking, heavy as shit, devastating rifle can still out-kill some of the best offerings from Tsunami and Arasaka. Just make sure to bring along an extra-large linear frame or bolt down your bipod, or else you won’t be able to shoulder this behemoth of love.

Cost: 4,600eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Anti-Material Rifle

Damage: 7d6 • Capacity: 4 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: NoSlots: 0 • Attachments: Magrail Kit (Bipod & Jue Long Scope), Smartgun Link, Sniping Scope, Sniper Long Barrel, Sniper Rifle Rechamber • Mods: Upsized Power

Special Features: This weapon’s scope uses a special filter that highlights visible targets and displays a mock readout of their ‘match rating’ compared to the weapon’s user. Whether this value is accurate or not is up to the GM, but mechanically it provides no bonus. Requires BODY 14+ to be wielded unless Mounted [Upsized Power].

Range: Anti-Material Rifle
Pre-installed: Magrail Kit (Bipod & Jue Long Scope), Smartgun Link, Sniping Scope, Sniper Long Barrel, Sniper Rifle Rechamber (effects already included in these stats)
Mods: Upsized Power

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
